rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a stanza when discussing the structure of a poem.

example.english: Each stanza of this poem has four lines.
example.traditional: 呢首詩每一詩節都有四行。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 si1 mui5 jat1 si1 zit3 dou1 jau5 sei3 hong4

rows.note: Use this colloquial general term when the context clearly shows that the section is a stanza of a poem.

example.english: I like the last stanza of this poem best.
example.traditional: 我最鍾意呢首詩最後嗰段。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ne1 sau2 si1 zeoi3 hau6 go2 dyun6
